title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
description: Prior LLM serving batched requests together and padded all sequences to the maximum length in the batch — wasting GPU time on padding tokens. Orca introduced **continuous batching** (iteration-level scheduling): each forward pass step processes a dynamic set of tokens from different requests, and new requests join mid-batch as old ones finish. This yielded up to 36.9× throughput improvement over static batching.
authors: Yu, Jeong, Kim, Kim, Kim, Chun, Choi (Seoul National University)
